title: LIQUIDITY_POOL_DEPOSIT fails with LIQUIDITY_POOL_DEPOSIT_POOL_FULL
pattern: A transaction whose LIQUIDITY_POOL_DEPOSIT operation fails at apply is still written into the closed ledger: its fee is charged, its sequence number is consumed, and nothing it did is kept. The result carries the operation's code (pool_full). The NRB/NRV pool holds i64::MAX of each asset; one more stroop would overflow its reserves.

hazards.placement: a pool holding i64::MAX of both assets

facts.says: No operation changed state: the operation meta is empty.
The fee is still charged: the fee source changes in fee processing.
